# Credits

## Photography

Demo catalog photos come from [Unsplash](https://unsplash.com) under the
[Unsplash License](https://unsplash.com/license): free to use, including
commercially, with no permission or attribution required. Every photo is
listed below by its Unsplash ID so it can be traced back to its source.

- Unsplash+ (paid) images were excluded.
- Every photo was checked by eye: anything showing a real fashion, shoe, watch
  or fragrance brand (logos, labels, signature bottle shapes) was dropped,
  because every brand on Queneth is fictional.
- Photos are loaded from Unsplash's CDN, not stored in this repository. If the
  CDN can't be reached, each image falls back to the generated SVG art.
